remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath corner-end townhome offering a comfortable blend of indoor and outdoor living. A spacious front patio and private backyard create inviting spaces to relax, entertain, or barbecue. Inside, the welcoming living room flows naturally into the kitchen and dining area. The kitchen features an electric range and oven, dishwasher, step-in pantry, and convenient breakfast bar. Nearby, the light-filled dining area is enhanced by a large sliding glass door that opens directly to the backyard, creating an easy connection between indoor and outdoor spaces.
